_README: Copy to dart_define.json (gitignored), fill in the real values, then build with: flutter build apk --release --dart-define-from-file=dart_define.json. Names and placeholders only in THIS file. Real values live in the gitignored CREDENTIALS.md (Rule 8) and in dart_define.json. Every key here must exist in lib/src/config/app_config.dart and vice versa - `npm run test:config` fails the build both ways.
_NEVER_PUT_HERE: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, or any other server-side secret. A --dart-define is compiled into the APK and an APK is a zip anyone can unpack. Server secrets belong to the /api handlers only.
